alvo.d225bcd9: A young man or woman wearing a hoodie approaches a man hole cover on the cobblestone street and looks around to ensure nobody watches him. He pulls the cover off, takes a final look around, and descends into the dark sewers, dropping off the last rung of the ladder and into the murky gross water, causing rats to scurry away from him and the light coming in from the open cover. He/she moves carefully along the large dark sewer, catches just a hint of voices ahead and pauses, straining their ears to listen. "There will be hell to pay" is the only thing they can understand, the rest of it too garbled as the voices seem to be retreating. He has a choice. Pursue or put greater distance between them. He choose to run for the exits, twisting and turning through the nasty corridors of pipe, garbage, debris, and scurrying creatures until at last finding a ladder with a small tarnished sign at the base that reads "Old World". He/she climbs quickly up the ladder, pushes the sewer cap away and is flooded by bright light of the sun.
alvo.05e57901:
A hooded figure descends into darkness... unnoticed.

He pulls the cover off, takes a final look around, and descends into the dark sewers.

Dropping into murky water, rats scurry away from the light above.

He moves carefully, catching a hint of voices... "There will be hell to pay."

The voices retreat; he must decide to follow... or flee.

Faster. Twisting. Escaping.

He chooses escape, racing through corridors until a ladder with "Old World" appears. Climbing quickly, he pushes the cap aside... and is flooded by sunlight. Follow for more.

Dozens of silent passengers stand outside the windows, staring at him. The doors open; cut to black before he steps out. planos_426e783f: A hooded figure steps silently into a dimly lit alley, shadows enveloping him as he disappears from sight.
The figure kneels, straining to lift a heavy manhole cover, glancing around before vanishing into the sewer below.
He drops into murky water, sending ripples through the darkness as startled rats dart away from the sudden light.
In the dark sewer, he pauses, straining to hear distant voices echoing, the ominous phrase lingering in the air.
As the voices fade, he hesitates, weighing his options in the narrow, damp tunnel, adrenaline coursing through him.
He sprints through the twisting tunnels, debris flying past as he pushes his limits to escape the unseen threat.
Reaching a ladder marked 'Old World', he scrambles up, pushing aside the cap, and bursts into radiant sunlight, squinting.
